articles.summary: DUBUQUE, Iowa --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mar. 10, 2026-- Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS) announced its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share, payable April 9, 2026, to shareholders of record as of March 30, 2026. Flexsteel has paid cash dividends on its common stock
articles.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
